variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: SAS has macro variables for text substitution and dataset variables for data processing.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.notes: SAS primarily uses only two data types: numeric and character. Dates are formatted numerics.

operators.title: Operators
operators.notes: Equality is `=` (not `==`). Not-equal can be `^=` or `ne`. Exponentiation is `**`.

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: In a DATA step, `if-then-else` is standard. Multi-statement blocks require `do; ... end;`.

for_loop.title: For Loop (Iterative DO)
for_loop.notes: The iterative `do` loop is used in the DATA step. `output` explicitly writes the observation.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.notes: `do while` evaluates the condition at the top of the loop. `do until` evaluates at the bottom.

functions.title: Functions (PROC FCMP)
functions.notes: Custom functions are created using PROC FCMP and stored in libraries for use in DATA steps.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: SAS arrays are temporary groupings of variables used to simplify processing within a DATA step.

maps.title: Hash Objects (Maps)
maps.notes: Hash objects in the DATA step provide fast, in-memory map/dictionary structures.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: Error handling is typically done using automatic macro variables like `&syserr.` after a step boundary.

comments.title: Comments & Headers
comments.code:
# Comment in SAS
# Multi-line comments or docstrings
# are documented here
comments.notes: SAS uses # or language-specific delimiters (% in MATLAB, ! in Fortran) for comments.

numbers.title: Vectors, Matrices & Numbers
numbers.notes: SAS is optimized for vector and matrix calculations with high-precision numerical representations.

booleans.title: Logical Vectors & Booleans
booleans.code:
is_valid = TRUE
flags = c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE)
booleans.notes: SAS provides boolean types with support for element-wise vector logic operations.

type_casting.title: Type Coercion & Casting
type_casting.notes: SAS converts data between numeric, character, factor, and logical representations.

strings.title: Strings & Character Vectors
strings.notes: SAS treats strings as atomic character scalars or vector arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: SAS formats numerical output with sprintf formatting specifiers.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Switches
pattern_matching.notes: SAS executes branch logic via switch, ifelse, or conditional filtering.

range.title: Sequences & Indexing
range.notes: SAS indexes matrices and vectors using 1-based indexing and sequence generators.

iterators.title: Vectorized Apply & Iteration
iterators.notes: SAS emphasizes vectorized functional processing (apply, map) over explicit loops.

oop_classes.title: Object Systems & S3/S4
oop_classes.code:
# Object systems in SAS
obj = list(name = "Model", score = 0.95)
class(obj) = "metric"
oop_classes.notes: SAS uses class dispatch systems (S3/S4 in R, multiple dispatch in Julia) for data modeling.

lists.title: DataFrames & Lists
lists.notes: SAS stores heterogeneous columnar records in data frames and lists.

tuples.title: Pairs & Records
tuples.notes: SAS uses named vectors or lightweight structures for data records.

sets.title: Set Operations
sets.notes: SAS provides native mathematical set functions (union, intersect, setdiff).

modules_import.title: Libraries & Packages
modules_import.notes: SAS loads package namespaces using library or import declarations.
